control.title: Media handling and secure disposal
control.description: Securely wipe or destroy media and equipment before disposal or re-use, and keep disposal certificates.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
acceptance_criteria: Disposal or wipe records name the device or media and the date
The method meets a recognised standard or a certificate from the disposal vendor is shown

criteria_coverage.criterion: Disposal or wipe records name the device or media and the date
The method meets a recognised standard or a certificate from the disposal vendor is shown

requirements.title: Identity and access management
requirements.guidance: Least privilege, MFA for privileged accounts, default credentials changed before go-live, session timeouts and removable media controls.

requirements.title: Disposal of assets
requirements.guidance: Remove data from assets before disposal or re-use.

requirements.title: Dispose of confidential information
requirements.guidance: Dispose of confidential information when no longer needed.

requirements.title: Storage media
requirements.guidance: Manage storage media through acquisition, use, transport and disposal.

requirements.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
requirements.guidance: Wipe or destroy data before disposing of or re-using equipment.

requirements.title: Information deletion
requirements.guidance: Delete information when no longer required.
